title: Zhytomyr clinch 2025/26 League 1 title!
description: Zhytomyr - Chayka 100-91 Zhytomyr clinched 2025/26 League 1 title beating Chayka 100-91 in the Final game. Trailing 21-28 at the end of the first quarter, Zhytomyr replied with a 27-17 run in the second frame and produced a marvellous 34-21 third quarter to win the game. Chayka won the last stanza 25-18 but could not catch up with the winners. Vadim Dovidniy (184-G-1993) led the winners with 29 points and Oleksandr Shepelev (201-F-1994) netted 25. Igor Starodub (182-PG-1997) and Tischenko netted 18 points each in a loss.

title: BIPA 2 celebrate 1 League 2024/25 title
description: BIPA 2 celebrated 1 League 2024/25 title in Ukraine. In the Final game they edged Khmelnytskyi 64-54. Trailing 13 points at the halftime, BIPA replied with a massive 17-1 surge in the third quarter and closed the campaign with a final 21-14 run. Naemtsu top-scored for the winners with 24 points and Igor Solovey (G-2002) posted 18. Maxim Gulya (190-G-2004) replied with 15 points in the losing effort.

title: BK Vinnitsya clinch 1 League title
description: BK Vinnitsya outgunned Rivne 2 80-62 in the Final game and clinched 1 League title. Yuriy Shkondya (188-G-1995) finished with 26 points and 8 rebounds for the champions. He was named the MVP. Evgeniy Romanov (185-G-1999) top scored with 33 points for BK Vinnitsya. Oleksandr Ponosov (187-G-2004, agency: BIG) answered with 16 points for Rivne 2. Poltava earned the third position as they held off BK Khmelnitskyi-2 73-69. Sergiy Melnyk (190-G-2001) tossed in 24 points and grabbed 7 rebounds for the winners.
imageCaption: BK Vinnitsya clinch 1 League title (Photo: fbu.ua)

title: Khmelnytskyi win Higher League
description: Khmelnytskyi have won the Higher League title as they won the Final series against Chernovtsi 2-1. In the decisive third game Khmelnytskyi posted a 93-88 win. They managed to win the last two quarters of the game for the trophy. Mikita Bazilev (183-PG-97) stepped up with 22 points and Vadim Paliukh (190-F-94) netted 20. Vladislav Lisanenko (195-SF-93) replied with 25 points and 12 rebounds in a loss.
